themes.name: Annual
themes.summary: An annual report: deep green, navy or burgundy with gold, a refined Baskerville for titles and figures, quarter-disc shapes and fine rules. Assured and polished, for annual reports, investor updates, results and donor reports.

themes.name: Atelier
themes.summary: Cream paper, a high-contrast serif and gold hairline frames with corner ornaments. Quiet and expensive, for fashion, hospitality, jewellery and premium brand decks.

themes.name: Aurora
themes.summary: Northern lights on near-black: green, cyan and violet glows drifting behind frosted cards, a clean geometric sans and a mono for code. Futuristic and calm, for AI, platform and developer talks, research demos and tech strategy.

themes.name: Bauhaus
themes.summary: Primary red, blue and yellow, a geometric sans, square corners and big circles and quarter discs. Confident and graphic, for design, architecture, art and bold strategy decks.

themes.name: Blocks
themes.summary: Toy bricks: primary red, blue and yellow, a round friendly sans, thick outlines and hard shadows, with big circles, triangles and half-discs. Bright and simple, for primary classes, children's workshops, school projects and family events.

themes.name: Bloom
themes.summary: Big friendly shapes, rounded type and dotted fields in bright colour. Warm and upbeat, for community, education and launch decks.

themes.name: Blueprint
themes.summary: A technical drawing: white lines on blueprint blue (or blue on a white drafting sheet), a fine grid, condensed headings, mono notes, a title block at the foot and dimension lines. For plans, engineering, architecture and how-it-works decks.

themes.name: Boardroom
themes.summary: Consulting style: white pages, serif action titles that state the point, a navy rail and fine rules, with a sober sans for the detail. Crisp and executive, for board papers, strategy reviews and recommendations.

themes.name: Brite
themes.summary: Neo-brutalist: thick black outlines, hard offset shadows and loud lime, cyan and yellow fills. Bold and playful, for creative pitches, hackathons, product demos and social posts.
themes.credit: colours from Bootswatch Brite by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Broadsheet
themes.summary: A front page: a heavy high-contrast serif headline, column rules, a masthead of thick and thin lines and one red for emphasis on newsprint. Authoritative and dense, for news roundups, investigations, digests and long reads.

themes.name: Chalk
themes.summary: A chalkboard (or whiteboard) with hand-written kickers and marks that draw themselves. Friendly and very readable, made for teaching.

themes.name: Collage
themes.summary: Cut paper on kraft: torn-edge blobs and leaves in tomato, mustard and ink blue, a soft display serif and handwritten notes. Warm and crafty, for community projects, workshops, fundraisers and creative briefs.

themes.name: Confetti
themes.summary: A party on warm white: a chunky playful sans, magenta and blue with sunny yellow, scattered dots, stars and a squiggle. Joyful and loud, for birthdays, launches, celebrations, awards and team parties.

themes.name: Crayon
themes.summary: A handwritten display face, round friendly body type, bright crayon colours, stars, squiggles and blobs. For classrooms, children's events, family days and anything aimed at kids.

themes.name: Dracula
themes.summary: The well-loved dark code colours: slate violet background, pink, purple, cyan and green, a mono face for labels and a dot grid. At home with developers, for engineering talks, tutorials, demos and release notes.
themes.credit: Dracula colours by Zeno Rocha and contributors (MIT licence)

themes.name: Field Manual
themes.summary: Industrial and stencilled: khaki paper, tall condensed uppercase headings, olive drab, safety-orange hazard stripes and square corners. Tough and practical, for operations, safety briefings, field guides and site plans.

themes.name: Flatly
themes.summary: Flat colour blocks in midnight blue and turquoise, clean sans type and no shadows. Clear and modern, for financial updates, dashboards, budgets and quarterly reviews.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Flatly by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Folio
themes.summary: Editorial: a serif display face over a crisp sans, folio lines, big italic section numbers and drop caps. For decks people read as much as watch.

themes.name: Gaia
themes.summary: Warm cream paper with slate blue-grey ink, a clear sky-blue accent and soft diagonal stripes on the title slides. Friendly and tidy, for lessons, study groups, tutorials and school talks.
themes.credit: colours from the Marp Gaia theme by the Marp team (MIT licence)

themes.name: Gallery
themes.summary: A quiet exhibition wall: italic serif titles, small spaced labels, pictures in white mats with wall-label captions and plenty of space. For portfolios, photography and work that should speak for itself.

themes.name: Grid
themes.summary: Swiss modernism: one bold grotesque, flush-left type on a visible twelve-column grid, thick rules, huge section numbers and the section name running up the margin. For design talks, strategy and reports that should look decisive.

themes.name: Grove
themes.summary: Calm and natural: a soft serif over a friendly sans, mist and moss colours, rounded cards with soft shadows and leaf and pebble shapes in the corners. For community, health, wellbeing and teaching decks.

themes.name: Journal
themes.summary: A newspaper feel: a narrow news sans for headlines over a readable serif, a masthead rule and coral red. Clear and wordy, for reports, newsletters, briefings, essays and research talks.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Journal by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Lab
themes.summary: A clean laboratory: cool white, a geometric sans, a mono for units and sample codes, teal and violet, with rings and dots like a molecule diagram. Precise and fresh, for science talks, experiments, results and research updates.

themes.name: Lanterns
themes.summary: A festival night: deep indigo, warm lantern glows and a soft sunburst, saffron, marigold or lotus pink, with a warm display serif. Festive and glowing, for Vesak, Deepavali, Christmas, Avurudu and other seasonal events.

themes.name: Launch
themes.summary: A product launch on deep navy: a bold geometric sans, a violet glow rising behind the title, an orange or cyan second colour and rounded cards. Energetic and modern, for launches, demo days, fundraising pitches and product updates.

themes.name: League
themes.summary: Tall condensed uppercase headlines on a charcoal spotlight, with an electric cyan accent and a sporty bar. Loud and energetic, for pitches, sports, rallies, event openers and big announcements.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from the reveal.js League theme by Hakim El Hattab and contributors (MIT licence)

themes.name: Ledger
themes.summary: The look of an annual report: a serif for headlines, a crisp sans for figures, a ticker strip across the top and accounting rules under totals. For numbers people will check.

themes.name: Letterpress
themes.summary: Wood type and ink on cream stock: a heavy slab for titles, a bookish serif for text, condensed caps for labels, double-ruled borders and printer's stars, in red and black. Handsome and old-fashioned, for heritage stories, craft businesses, menus and announcements.

themes.name: Litera
themes.summary: A bookish serif for reading, a clean sans for headings, plenty of white space and a calm blue. Thoughtful and easy to follow, for lectures, literature reviews, essays and long reports.
themes.credit: colours from Bootswatch Litera by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Lux
themes.summary: Black, white and a touch of gold, with widely spaced uppercase headings and fine hairline frames. Quiet and expensive, for brand books, product launches, property, fashion and premium services.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Lux by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Marble
themes.summary: Polished stone: cool white with faint veining, a high-contrast Bodoni for titles, a clean geometric sans and fine gold or emerald frames. Rich and composed, for luxury brands, hospitality, property, jewellery and high-end launches.

themes.name: Meridian
themes.summary: A clean modern sans with a thin progress line that carries the section name. Calm and precise, it suits almost any deck.

themes.name: Minty
themes.summary: Fresh mint and soft pink on white, rounded corners and gentle blobs, with a friendly geometric sans for headings. Calm and welcoming, for lessons, workshops, health talks and community sessions.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Minty by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Mono
themes.summary: Black and white only, Swiss style: a neutral grotesque, a mono for labels, hairline rules, square corners and one small black dot. Severe and clear, for design talks, architecture, manifestos and content that needs no colour.

themes.name: Night
themes.summary: Near-black slides, a bold geometric sans for headings and a warm amber accent that glows in one corner. Focused and dramatic, for keynotes, evening talks, product stories and tech demos.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from the reveal.js Night theme by Hakim El Hattab and contributors (MIT licence)

themes.name: Noir
themes.summary: A keynote on a dark stage: a light serif for headlines, a spotlight glow that moves from slide to slide, and cinema bars on full-bleed photos. One idea per slide. For launches, keynotes and talks with few words.

themes.name: Occasion
themes.summary: An invitation: centred covers, a classic serif with a script for names, gold on deep colour and a double-rule frame with corner flourishes. For weddings, celebrations, awards, Avurudu and Vesak events.

themes.name: Pop
themes.summary: Loud and playful: heavy rounded type, bold block colours, ink outlines with hard shadows and big cut-out shapes. For decks that should feel like an event.

themes.name: Quant
themes.summary: Dense and numeric: white or terminal black, a tight grotesque, a mono for figures and labels, faint grid lines and a ticker strip. Exact and data-heavy, for market updates, risk reports, trading reviews and analytics.

themes.name: Quartz
themes.summary: Frosted glass panels over a soft violet glow, with a hot pink accent and a rounded modern sans. Dreamy and polished, for portfolios, design reviews, creative briefs and launch moods.
themes.credit: colours from Bootswatch Quartz by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Risograph
themes.summary: A riso print: cream paper, two bright inks (pink and blue, or orange and teal) laid over each other, halftone dots, a heavy grotesque and a mono. Lively and handmade, for zines, art shows, community events and indie launches.

themes.name: Sandstone
themes.summary: Warm paper, a dependable sans with small uppercase labels, slate blue and a burnt orange. Steady and approachable, for team updates, plans, proposals and client meetings.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Sandstone by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Schematic
themes.summary: An engineering drawing: white graph paper, black linework, corner crop marks, a red mark-up colour and a mono for dimensions and labels. Precise and technical, for design reviews, specifications, architecture and hardware talks.

themes.name: Seminar
themes.summary: Academic and exact: a book serif, a running head with numbered sections (2.3), numbered figure captions, footnote rules and book-style tables. For lectures, research talks, theses and training.

themes.name: Seventies
themes.summary: A soft retro serif, warm cream paper and rainbow arcs in orange, mustard and brown. Relaxed and nostalgic, for music, food, culture and community decks.

themes.name: Signal
themes.summary: A developer's screen: dark first, a sharp sans with mono details, a faint dot grid, code-comment kickers and an editor status bar with the page count. For product, tech and data talks.

themes.name: Simple
themes.summary: Black on white with one deep blue, a compact news sans for headings and almost no decoration. Plain and fast to read, for working sessions, internal updates, notes and quick explainers.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from the reveal.js Simple theme by Hakim El Hattab and contributors (MIT licence)

themes.name: Sketchy
themes.summary: Hand-drawn: sketched headings, a handwritten label face, wobbly outlines and doodled stars on white. Loose and friendly, for classrooms, kids clubs, brainstorms and early ideas.
themes.credit: fonts and look from Bootswatch Sketchy by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Sky
themes.summary: Pale blue sky light, a soft rounded sans for headings and a clear blue accent, with a gentle wave along the foot. Light and optimistic, for wellbeing talks, travel, outdoor programmes and onboarding.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from the reveal.js Sky theme by Hakim El Hattab and contributors (MIT licence)

themes.name: Solar
themes.summary: The Solarized colours: deep teal-black or warm cream, muted greys and eight clear accents, with a sun of rays on the cover. Easy on the eyes, for developer talks, technical reviews and data walk-throughs.
themes.credit: Solarized colours by Ethan Schoonover (MIT licence), as used in Bootswatch Solar by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Studio
themes.summary: A design studio look: off-white walls, a wide expressive display face, a mono for captions, one electric accent and an outlined ring. Confident and image-led, for portfolios, case studies, agency pitches and creative reviews.

themes.name: Superhero
themes.summary: Deep navy, square corners, a bold sans and a hot orange accent, with a faint sunburst behind the cover. Confident and punchy, for pitches, launches, sales kick-offs and team rallies.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Superhero by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Thesis
themes.summary: Ivory paper, a classic Garamond for titles and text, Oxford blue and a double-ruled frame on the title page. Scholarly and calm, for theses, defences, lectures and conference papers.

themes.name: Tide
themes.summary: The calm of the sea: pale foam, deep navy ink, teal and sand, a soft serif for titles and layered waves along the foot. Restful and clear, for wellbeing, ocean and climate talks, retreats, travel and coaching.

themes.name: Uncover
themes.summary: Centred, airy and nearly bare: a crisp sans, soft off-white paper and one bright blue rule under each title. Clean and modern, for talks, explainers, product walkthroughs and teaching.
themes.credit: colours from the Marp Uncover theme by the Marp team (MIT licence)

themes.name: United
themes.summary: Warm orange and deep aubergine on white, with a round, open sans and solid colour bands. Friendly and dependable, for team updates, open-source projects, community plans and all-hands.
themes.credit: colours from Bootswatch United by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Vapor
themes.summary: Synthwave night: deep violet, neon cyan text, hot pink and a setting sun over a grid. Retro and electric, for game nights, music, creative tech talks and anything with an 80s wink.
themes.credit: colours and fonts from Bootswatch Vapor by Thomas Park (MIT licence)

themes.name: Wedding
themes.summary: Soft and romantic: blush paper, an elegant Garamond with italics, fine frames and leaf sprigs, in sage, rose or dusk blue. Graceful and quiet, for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, invitations and memorial programmes.

themes.name: Zen
themes.summary: Warm off-white space, a light sans, wide-spaced labels and a single brush-like ring. Calm and spare, for reflective talks, wellness, design reviews and quiet reports.
